mcq.q: What does the Arabic word خِزَانَةٌ (khizaana) mean?
mcq.explanation: خِزَانَةٌ (khizaana) means cupboard.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word قَوِيٌّ (qawiyy) mean?
mcq.explanation: قَوِيٌّ (qawiyy) means strong.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word أُخْتٌ (ukht) mean?
mcq.explanation: أُخْتٌ (ukht) means sister.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence جَدَّتِي تُحِبُّنِي mean?
options: I have a brother and a sister.
mcq.explanation: جَدَّتِي تُحِبُّنِي (jaddatii tuhibbunii) means: My grandmother loves me.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word مَطَرٌ (matar) mean?
mcq.explanation: مَطَرٌ (matar) means rain.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word بَطْنٌ (batn) mean?
mcq.explanation: بَطْنٌ (batn) means stomach.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "sun"?
mcq.explanation: شَمْسٌ (shams) means sun.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "good morning"?
mcq.explanation: صَبَاحُ الْخَيْرِ (sabaahu l-khayr) means good morning.

mcq.q: Which of these is a masculine noun?
mcq.explanation: kursii is masculine. The other words end in -a and are feminine.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "at (near, by)"?
mcq.explanation: عِنْدَ (ʿinda) means at (near, by).

mcq.q: What does al-jawwu mumtir mean?
mcq.explanation: mumtir means rainy.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word حَلِيبٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: حَلِيبٌ is read haliib and means milk.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word ارْفَعْ يَدَكَ (irfaʿ yadaka) mean?
mcq.explanation: ارْفَعْ يَدَكَ (irfaʿ yadaka) means raise your hand.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "mother's sister"?
mcq.explanation: خَالَةٌ (khaala) means mother's sister.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word اِلْمَسْ أَنْفَكَ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: اِلْمَسْ أَنْفَكَ is read ilmis anfaka and means touch your nose.

mcq.q: Which phrase do you use to thank the audience?
mcq.explanation: shukran li-istimaaʿikum means 'thank you for listening'.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "I have a brother and a sister."
mcq.explanation: عِنْدِي أَخٌ وَأُخْتٌ (ʿindii akh wa ukht) means: I have a brother and a sister.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "I have a gift."
mcq.explanation: عِنْدِي هَدِيَّةٌ (ʿindii hadiyya) means: I have a gift.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word فَوْقَ (fawqa) mean?
mcq.explanation: فَوْقَ (fawqa) means above.

mcq.q: A girl asks another girl maa ismuki? What is she asking?
mcq.explanation: maa ismuki? asks a girl for her name. The ending -ki is used for a girl.

mcq.q: Which style is old, angular and has straight lines?
mcq.explanation: Kufic is an old angular style used for decoration and old manuscripts.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence كُلَّ عَامٍ وَأَنْتُمْ بِخَيْرٍ mean?
options: May you be well every year.
Do you have a party? (to a boy)
mcq.explanation: كُلَّ عَامٍ وَأَنْتُمْ بِخَيْرٍ (kulla ʿaamin wa-antum bi-khayr) means: May you be well every year.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence كَيْفَ الْجَوُّ الْيَوْمَ؟ mean?
mcq.explanation: كَيْفَ الْجَوُّ الْيَوْمَ؟ (kayfa l-jawwu l-yawm?) means: How is the weather today?

mcq.q: Which sentence gives your own name?
mcq.explanation: ismii means 'my name is', so ismii Ahmad means 'My name is Ahmad'.

mcq.q: What is the name of the Arabic letter ع?
mcq.explanation: The letter ع is called ʿayn.

mcq.q: In what order do you say the letters when you spell an Arabic word aloud?
mcq.explanation: We spell Arabic in the direction it is written, from right to left.

mcq.q: Which is a fault in handwriting?
mcq.explanation: Wide gaps inside a word make it look like several words.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word مَدْرَسَةٌ (madrasa) mean?
mcq.explanation: مَدْرَسَةٌ (madrasa) means school.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word عَصِيرٌ (ʿasiir) mean?
mcq.explanation: عَصِيرٌ (ʿasiir) means juice.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "Thank you for listening."
mcq.explanation: شُكْرًا لِاسْتِمَاعِكُمْ (shukran li-istimaaʿikum) means: Thank you for listening.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "salt"?
mcq.explanation: مِلْحٌ (milh) means salt.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word طَاوِلَةٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: طَاوِلَةٌ is read taawila and means table.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word ابْنٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: ابْنٌ is read ibn and means son.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence أَتَكَلَّمُ بِفَمِي mean?
mcq.explanation: أَتَكَلَّمُ بِفَمِي (atakallamu bi-famii) means: I speak with my mouth.

mcq.q: Which word fills the gap in: ashrabu ____ (I drink the juice)?
mcq.explanation: We drink juice, not cake, a party or a balloon.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word بِنْتٌ (bint) mean?
mcq.explanation: بِنْتٌ (bint) means daughter.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word خَالَةٌ (khaala) mean?
mcq.explanation: خَالَةٌ (khaala) means mother's sister.

mcq.q: What is the correct reply to shukran (thank you)?
mcq.explanation: ʿafwan means 'you are welcome' and is the polite reply to thanks.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word ظَهْرٌ (dhahr) mean?
mcq.explanation: ظَهْرٌ (dhahr) means back.

mcq.q: What is rhyme?
options: Words or lines that end with the same sound
mcq.explanation: Rhyme is when words or lines end with the same sound.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word ذُرَةٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: ذُرَةٌ is read dhura and means maize.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word دَجَاجٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: دَجَاجٌ is read dajaaj and means chicken.

mcq.q: What is meant by listening for the gist?
mcq.explanation: The gist is the main idea. You do not need to understand every word.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word أَغْمِضْ عَيْنَيْكَ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: أَغْمِضْ عَيْنَيْكَ is read aghmiD ʿaynayka and means close your eyes.

mcq.q: Which sound does the Arabic letter ج make?
mcq.explanation: The letter ج makes the sound j as in jug.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence هَدِيَّةٌ لِأَمِينَةَ mean?
options: Above the table there is a balloon.
On the table there is a cake.
mcq.explanation: هَدِيَّةٌ لِأَمِينَةَ (hadiyya li-Aminata) means: A gift for Amina.

mcq.q: Which mark gives the short vowel 'a'?
options: kasra, a small line below the letter
Damma, a small curl above the letter
fatHa, a small slanted line above the letter
mcq.explanation: fatHa is the mark for the short vowel a.

mcq.q: Which word do you use for 'This is ...' before a feminine word such as shams?
mcq.explanation: haadhihi is used with feminine words and haadhaa with masculine words.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence أُمِّي تَطْبُخُ mean?
options: I have a brother and a sister.
mcq.explanation: أُمِّي تَطْبُخُ (ummii tatbukhu) means: My mother cooks.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word بَابٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: بَابٌ is read baab and means door.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word عِنْدَ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: عِنْدَ is read ʿinda and means at (near, by).

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence أُخْتِي تَقْرَأُ mean?
options: I have a brother and a sister.
mcq.explanation: أُخْتِي تَقْرَأُ (ukhtii taqraʾu) means: My sister reads.

mcq.q: Which sentence means 'I plant a tree'?
mcq.explanation: azraʿu means I plant and shajara means tree.

mcq.q: Which sound does the Arabic letter م make?
mcq.explanation: The letter م makes the sound m as in mat.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word أَبٌ (ab) mean?
mcq.explanation: أَبٌ (ab) means father.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence آكُلُ الْأَرُزَّ mean?
mcq.explanation: آكُلُ الْأَرُزَّ (aakulu l-aruzza) means: I eat rice.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence هَذِهِ حَفْلَةٌ mean?
options: The friends are at the party.
On the table there is a cake.
Above the table there is a balloon.
mcq.explanation: هَذِهِ حَفْلَةٌ (haadhihi hafla) means: This is a party.

mcq.q: Which of these is unique about Arabic writing?
options: It is written from right to left
mcq.explanation: Arabic runs from right to left and has 28 letters and no capitals.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "Do you have a party? (to a boy)"
mcq.explanation: هَلْ عِنْدَكَ حَفْلَةٌ؟ (hal ʿindaka hafla?) means: Do you have a party? (to a boy)

mcq.q: How do you read the syllable لَا?
mcq.explanation: لَا is read laa.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "ear"?
mcq.explanation: أُذُنٌ (udhun) means ear.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word مِفْتَاحٌ (miftaah) mean?
mcq.explanation: مِفْتَاحٌ (miftaah) means key.

mcq.q: Which sentence means 'The window is clean'?
mcq.explanation: naafidha is window and nadhiifa is the feminine form of clean.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "food"?
mcq.explanation: طَعَامٌ (taʿaam) means food.

mcq.q: Which sound does the Arabic letter ث make?
options: kh, a throat sound like the ch in loch
mcq.explanation: The letter ث makes the sound th as in think.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word جَدَّةٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: جَدَّةٌ is read jadda and means grandmother.

mcq.q: What are the three parts of a short speech?
mcq.explanation: A speech opens by greeting, gives the main information and closes by thanking.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word لِسَانٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: لِسَانٌ is read lisaan and means tongue.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence الْأَصْدِقَاءُ فِي الْحَفْلَةِ mean?
options: On the table there is a cake.
The friends are at the party.
Above the table there is a balloon.
mcq.explanation: الْأَصْدِقَاءُ فِي الْحَفْلَةِ (al-asdiqaa'u fii l-hafla) means: The friends are at the party.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word ذُرَةٌ (dhura) mean?
mcq.explanation: ذُرَةٌ (dhura) means maize.

mcq.q: What should you check on a food chart before posting it?
mcq.explanation: Checking the words helps to avoid mistakes.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence asks 'How is the weather today?'
mcq.explanation: kayfa means how, al-jawwu is the weather and al-yawm is today.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence الطَّاوِلَةُ صَغِيرَةٌ mean?
mcq.explanation: الطَّاوِلَةُ صَغِيرَةٌ (at-taawilatu Sagiira) means: The table is small.

mcq.q: In a short speech, what does the sentence anaa fii S-Saffi r-raabiʿ mean?
mcq.explanation: Saff means class and raabiʿ means fourth.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word حَدِيقَةٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: حَدِيقَةٌ is read hadiiqa and means garden.

mcq.q: What does shaping of characters mean?
options: Writing each letter in its correct shape
mcq.explanation: Each letter must have its known shape so the reader can read it.

mcq.q: What is the name of the Arabic letter ز?
mcq.explanation: The letter ز is called zaay.

mcq.q: What does hal do at the start of an Arabic question?
options: It makes a yes or no question
mcq.explanation: hal begins a question that can be answered with naʿam or laa.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "The chair is new."
mcq.explanation: الْكُرْسِيُّ جَدِيدٌ (al-kursiyyu jadiid) means: The chair is new.

mcq.q: Which is the correct blend of the syllables a + bun?
mcq.explanation: The syllables are read in order: a then bun gives abun (father).

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence الْعَصِيرُ بَارِدٌ mean?
mcq.explanation: الْعَصِيرُ بَارِدٌ (al-ʿasiiru baarid) means: The juice is cold.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "window"?
mcq.explanation: نَافِذَةٌ (naafidha) means window.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence فَوْقَ الطَّاوِلَةِ بَالُونٌ mean?
options: On the table there is a cake.
Above the table there is a balloon.
The friends are at the party.
mcq.explanation: فَوْقَ الطَّاوِلَةِ بَالُونٌ (fawqa t-taawilati baaluun) means: Above the table there is a balloon.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence الْبَابُ كَبِيرٌ mean?
mcq.explanation: الْبَابُ كَبِيرٌ (al-baabu kabiir) means: The door is big.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence كَيْفَ حَالُكِ؟ mean?
mcq.explanation: كَيْفَ حَالُكِ؟ (kayfa haaluki?) means: How are you? (to a girl)

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "father"?
mcq.explanation: أَبٌ (ab) means father.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word نَهْرٌ (nahr) mean?
mcq.explanation: نَهْرٌ (nahr) means river.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence أَيْنَ الْكِتَابُ؟ mean?
options: The book is on the table.
The lamp is above the table.
The cat is under the bed.
mcq.explanation: أَيْنَ الْكِتَابُ؟ (ayna l-kitaab?) means: Where is the book?

mcq.q: Which of these is a characteristic of good handwriting?
mcq.explanation: Good handwriting has even spacing, correct shapes and neat presentation.

mcq.q: How do you read the syllable بِي?
mcq.explanation: بِي is read bii.

mcq.q: Which letter is missing in الجم_ة?
mcq.explanation: The word is الجمعة, al-jumuʿa, Friday.

mcq.q: What does the shadda over the last letter of umm tell the reader?
mcq.explanation: A shadda doubles the sound.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "The banana is delicious."
mcq.explanation: الْمَوْزُ لَذِيذٌ (al-mawzu ladhiidh) means: The banana is delicious.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word خَلْفَ (khalfa) mean?
mcq.explanation: خَلْفَ (khalfa) means behind.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "I go to school on Monday."
mcq.explanation: أَذْهَبُ إِلَى الْمَدْرَسَةِ يَوْمَ الِاثْنَيْنِ (adhhabu ilaa l-madrasa yawma l-ithnayn) means: I go to school on Monday.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "goodbye"?
mcq.explanation: مَعَ السَّلَامَةِ (maʿa s-salaama) means goodbye.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word كَيْفَ حَالُكَ؟ (kayfa haaluka?) mean?
mcq.explanation: كَيْفَ حَالُكَ؟ (kayfa haaluka?) means How are you? (to a boy).

mcq.q: The cat is under the bed. Which position word is used?
mcq.explanation: taHta means under.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "Today is Thursday."
mcq.explanation: الْيَوْمُ يَوْمُ الْخَمِيسِ (al-yawmu yawmu l-khamiis) means: Today is Thursday.

mcq.q: What is the name of the Arabic letter غ?
mcq.explanation: The letter غ is called ghayn.
